copy-with-cp.title: Copy a File with `cp`
copy-with-cp.bodyMarkdown:
`cp source destination` creates another file while keeping the source in place.

```bash
cp itinerary.txt backups/itinerary.txt
```

Verify that both source and destination exist afterward.

move-with-mv.title: Move a File with `mv`
move-with-mv.bodyMarkdown: `mv source destination` relocates a file. After a successful move, the old path is gone and the destination path exists.

rename-with-mv.title: Rename a File with `mv`
rename-with-mv.bodyMarkdown:
`mv` also renames a file when the destination is a different name in the same directory.

```bash
mv draft.txt final.txt
```
